stories.title: Blackout Day 4 — Contact Resumes Monday, Then the Race Begins

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Day 4 of the recruiting blackout. Coaches can't call. Can't text. Can't DM.

One day left of silence — then Monday arrives and the entire sport springs back to life at once.

The portal opens Tuesday. Signing Day starts Wednesday.

72 hours changes everything. 🥎

stories.title: 3 Days Until the Portal — Arizona's Desperation Race for a Pitcher

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Arizona lost D1Softball Player of the Year Mariah Torres to Texas Tech in June.

Three days until the December portal opens — and the Wildcats still don't have an ace.

The most desperate team in college softball is about to enter the most competitive pitching market of the year.

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Portal opens in 72 hours. 🥎

Programs chasing pitchers on Day 1:
▸ Arizona (no ace after Torres to TTU)
▸ Ole Miss (rotation thin)
▸ Auburn (targeting power arms)

The window is 7 effective days before the Dec 8-12 dead period hits. Every hour counts.

stories.title: Oklahoma's No. 1 Class vs. the Ace Question

Oklahoma's 2027 class has the No. 1 outfielder. No. 2 catcher. A top-10 infielder.

What it doesn't have: an ace.

Vivian Knott visits Norman. Kinsley Boulware visits Norman.

Signing Day is 4 days away.

Patty Gasso has never missed on a class. This week, we find out why. 🥎
